title: Gravity gets weaker when objects are farther apart
summary: The pull of gravity gets weaker as the distance between objects grows, and stronger when they are closer.
body: NASA Space Place says gravity gets weaker with distance, so objects pull harder on each other when they are closer. The page does not state the sharper distance rule that a textbook puts in the gravitation chapter. This card is only the Space Place sentence, from the article dated 17 December 2020.

sources.title: What Is Gravity?
sources.author: NASA Space Place
sources.note: NASA Space Place, article last updated 17 December 2020. Paraphrase of the page's own sentence. Public-domain US federal page. Supports 'gravity also gets weaker with distance' and the closer-stronger sentence.
